The event was won by Khalid Skah in 27:23:29 with Italy's Salvatore Antibo in close attendance. Gary placed 6th in the race, the second European home, and the first thirteen runners cracked 28 minutes.
Olympic 10k champion Khalid Skah won as he pleased but Paul Evans was the pick of the Brits., racing home to 2nd place, 19 seconds behind in 13:58, to go to the top of the road rankings.
Paul's 28:13 was 5 seconds inside Khalid Skah's course record. In both races the runner up was Kenyan Chege, outkicked by the Belgravian's final surge.
